offence_note: Criminal organization drug trafficking, conspiracy, firearms, obstruction offences
co_offenders: Shane Evans: 9.5 years reduced to net 2.5 years after 84 months credit; Francis: sentence upheld; Green: net 5.5 years upheld
sentence_quote: I would grant leave to appeal sentence, but dismiss all appeals from sentence except that of the appellant Shane Evans, whose appeal I would allow and whose sentence I would reduce by 84 months to a net sentence of 2.5 years.
note: First-named Sheldon Evans sentence length not shown; appeal dismissed for him; only Shane's reduced.

offence_note: Sexual assault and touching of minors, threats, firearm for dangerous purpose
sentence_quote: That sentence which totals five years and six months will be reduced by one year to a total sentence of four years and six months, to take into account the principles of totality.
note: Judge declined s. 161 order; victim surcharge $1,100.

offence_note: Robbery, forcible confinement, sexual assault; dangerous offender
sentence_quote: the appellant was found to be a dangerous offender and sentenced to serve an indeterminate sentence by His Honour Judge Paradis of the Provincial Court
note: Appeal from dangerous offender finding dismissed.

offence_note: Trafficking cocaine twice and possession for purpose of trafficking
sentence_quote: I sentence you, Mr. Russell, to imprisonment for a term of five years on Count 2, five years on Count 3, and four years on Count 4, all to be served concurrently and consecutively to the term of imprisonment imposed by Mr. Justice Powers on May 15, 2009.
note: Five years appears to be after five months credit; consecutive to earlier two-year sentence; lifetime s. 109 ban.

offence_note: Possession of crack cocaine for the purpose of trafficking
sentence_quote: Accordingly, I sentence you to imprisonment for a period of six months.

offence_note: Fraud over $5,000 by fictitious travel claims
sentence_quote: The sentence of this Court is that you be incarcerated at the Burnside Facility for a period of six months. Following your term of incarceration you will be placed on probation for a period of one year.
note: Restitution and community service are probation conditions.

offence_note: Possession of cocaine and ecstasy for the purpose of trafficking
sentence_quote: was sentenced to forty-one months' imprisonment, in addition to 7 months' credit for restrictive pre-sentence bail.
note: Credit was for restrictive bail, not custody.

offence_note: Assault causing bodily harm; failing to comply with undertaking
sentence_quote: The sentencing judge sentenced the appellant to 5 ½ months imprisonment for the assault and two months concurrent on each fail to comply.
note: Weapons prohibition five years; 5.5 months written as 5m 15d.

offence_note: Uttering threat to cause bodily harm to probation officer
sentence_quote: Mr. Felteau is sentenced to 349 days on that charge. The sentence is to be served concurrently with the sentences imposed on the other counts in the information.
note: Crown appeal from acquittal allowed; appeal court entered conviction and sentenced itself.

sentence_quote: I would allow the appeal, and vary the appellant's sentence to bring it into conformity with the joint submission, namely, that the appellant serve an additional 18 months in custody, with no period of probation to follow.
note: Total length not stated; about 11 months pre-sentence custody plus further 18 months; trial judge's probation removed.
